content.short: Moonly is an NFT analytics toolset offering live market data and metrics like mint price, supply, floor price, volume, and engagement.
content.description: Moonly provides a set of advanced tools that help NFT enthusiasts and investors make informed decisions about their collections. Users can review essential NFT statistics, including mint price, total supply, floor price, trading volume, and price movements, alongside engagement signals from Twitter and Discord. The platform also makes live market data accessible for developers. Moonly offers a suite of free tools while developing premium features that will be available to NFT holders, expanding the toolkit for smarter asset management.
content.meta: Moonly provides NFT analytics tools to help users invest smarter. Discover Moonly and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
